entry.title: BIP Draft Post-Quantum Address Format (bc1z) using ML-DSA-65
entry.summary:
Significant efforts have been devoted over recent years to the exploration, research, and development of post-quantum cryptography (PQC) solutions for Bitcoin. This ongoing work encompasses extensive discussions within mailing lists, collaborative forums such as Delving Bitcoin, in-person meetings, and detailed BIP (Bitcoin Improvement Proposal) debates. Participants are encouraged to familiarize themselves with the breadth of prior work available through these channels to ensure a comprehensive understanding of the current landscape and avoid redundancy in ongoing proposals.
A recent draft BIP proposing a quantum-resistant address format for Bitcoin was introduced as part of the [safe-btc project](https://github.com/Zaenus/btc-safe). However, concerns were raised regarding the proliferation of language model-generated PQC proposals that are initiated without substantial groundwork or community review. Such rapidly produced proposals, particularly those developed in under forty-eight hours, are unlikely to offer the transformative solutions needed by the Bitcoin ecosystem. Thorough research and engagement with existing literature and discourse remain critical for meaningful advancement in this area.
